criteria.statement: Dashboard opens a scoped Nostr REQ for kinds 31975, 31976, 31977, and 31978 filtered by Bahia service pubkey and bahia tag.
Validated EVENT callbacks upsert DNS zones, endpoints, policies, and backends using parameterized replaceable d-tag semantics and tombstones.
EOSE marks historical catch-up complete and CLOSED/AUTH conditions are represented in visible dashboard state.
The DNS page removes the manual refresh flow and filters locally over live Nostr state.
